If the cow chases the lion and the cow chases the cat then the lion needs the cow. If the tiger chases the cow then the tiger likes the cat. If something needs the lion then the lion needs the tiger. If something chases the cow then the cow likes the tiger. If something chases the cat then the cat chases the cow. If something is cold then it chases the cat. If something is cold and it chases the cat then it chases the cow.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
The tiger likes the cow.

Needs(Lion, Tiger, True) ::: The lion needs the tiger.
Likes(Tiger, Cow, True) ::: The tiger likes the cow.

Likes($x, Tiger, True) >>> Cold(Tiger, True) ::: If something likes the tiger then the tiger is cold.

Chases(Tiger, Cow, True) >>> Likes(Tiger, Cat, True) ::: If the tiger chases the cow then the tiger likes the cat.

Cold($x, True) >>> Chases($x, Cat, True) ::: If something is cold then it chases the cat.
Cold($x, True) && Chases($x, Cat, True) >>> Chases($x, Cow, True) ::: If something is cold and it chases the cat then it chases the cow.
